title.zh: 大气环流与季风 · 风从哪里来
title.en: Atmospheric Circulation & Monsoons · Where Winds Come From

desc.zh: 赤道多晒、极地少晒，空气因此转圈；地球自转把圈拧成三圈和信风，陆海温差又让风随季节掉头。
desc.en: The equator gets more sun than the poles, so air turns over in loops; Earth’s spin twists them into three cells and trade winds, and land–sea contrast flips the wind with the season.
